name: The Cosmic Slop
description: In the mid 1960's, Soul and Rock and Roll decided to get freaky and had a love child known to the public solely as "Funk"...what followed was a general musical inclination to this new style of danceable music. Funk's influence extended to Disco in the 70s, which in turn was a predecessor to modern day House. In the 80s, Funk branched off into Electro funk, which then evolved into modern day Techno. DJs in the Bronx, NY began looping the breaks in Funk songs and improvised over the loop in spoken word, laying the groundwork for what was jokingly referred to as "Hip Hop." In this show, listeners will explore the origins, influence and legacy of one of music's most historically significant genres...
